policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O delays Astra release amid cyber review
items.summary: Reporting says O is pausing some model work and delaying its upcoming Astra release while re-evaluating safety practices after technical incident work. Likely impacts near-term product cadence and risk posture.

items.headline: G reacts to reported China-shipment plan
items.summary: A report claimed shipments of G-based LPUs to China by year-end; Nvidia reportedly denied any China-specific roadmap item. This reduces geopolitical/export uncertainty premium on near-term supply assumptions.

items.headline: O ChatGPT release notes: model retirements
items.summary: O’s ChatGPT release notes show ongoing lifecycle changes (sunset/retirements) across multiple models, including schedule updates for specific variants. This can affect user/enterprise workflows tied to those models.

items.headline: G closes $350M Series A; $3.5B eval cited
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A fundraise led by Disruptive with planned NVIDIA participation. Coverage and signals indicate a ~$3.5B post-money valuation, supporting capacity for its inference/“neocloud” direction.

items.headline: G names NVIDIA cloud-partner status
items.summary: G announced it became an NVIDIA cloud partner and tied it to bringing “G 3 LPX” and associated stack elements to market. This supports go-to-market momentum and deployment tailwinds.
